thread:
Aisha (CSM): Hey team — NovaCorp dedicated bring-up is scheduled Thu 09:00 PST. Final checklist: quota mapping, autoscale thresholds, smoke + sustained load tests, and enablement doc for their SREs. They told us target sustained 600 RPS w/ short spikes to 2k for ~30s. Renewal in 9 months; this onboarding is flagged for account health review.

Tom (SRE): Copy. Can someone attach the traffic histogram? I need p50/p95 token lengths to size slot configs. Also we should set a soft-throttle + burst policy so we don't OOM on the backend GPUs. @Li can you advise on KV cache warmup?

Aisha (CSM): Pasted quick profile from their sampling: p50=64 tokens, p95=210, avg prompt size ~320 tokens (including context). I'll DM the full CSV.

Li (Infra Eng): Good — with p95 210 we should pick pool slots with max_seq 512 to avoid fragmentation. For autoscale: suggest min_slots=4, target_cpu_util=68%, scale_step=2, cooldown=90s. Set fallback to a smaller-quantized model if latency > 600ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows.

Priya (Solutions Eng): For load tests I'm proposing two phases: quick smoke (10m, 10–15% load) then soak (2h, target 600 RPS). Spike test script to emulate bursts: 30s ramp to 2k, hold 30s, drop over 40s. Use our load harness and collect token-level latency traces.

Marco (CSM): I'll coordinate enablement: runbook + quickstart for their SREs, and a 30-min handoff call post-soak to walk through consoles, cost dashboard, and how to interpret rollouts. Also capture their top 3 failure modes for a risk register.

Tom (SRE): Can we confirm quotas? They requested reserved capacity for 12 GPUs but committed vCPU/GPU quotas look like this: reserved_gpus=10, burst_allowed=+20% if spare. We should lock the gate for the first 24h to avoid accidental traffic spikes.

Aisha (CSM): Quota on the contract: 10 reserved GPUs, with ops-burst clause. Customer asked for autoscale headroom for business hours. I'll flag renewal risk: if we see >2 throttles during onboarding, renewal score drops by one tier. Need clean run.

Li (Infra Eng): Ops checklist — KMS rotation window at 02:00 UTC the night before; avoid key rotation during warmup. Also pre-warm KV cache: run synthetic prefix priming with ~50k cached tokens per slot using small-batch priming job:

```
# priming example (run from infra jumpbox)
python priming.py --endpoint https://dedicated-us.redwood/api/prime \
  --slots 8 --concurrency 40 --prefix-dir ./samples --duration 1800
```

Priya (Solutions Eng): Load generator commands (use test tenancy creds):

```
./loadgen --url https://dedicated-us.redwood/api/generate \
  --concurrency 200 --qps 600 --burst 2000 --burst-duration 30 --duration 7200 \
  --headers 'x-customer-id:NOVACORP' --log-level info
```

Marco (CSM): I'll send the invite for Thu 09:00 PST with the following agenda: 1) quick runbook review 2) smoke test 3) soak + spike run 4) post-mortem + enablement. Also including billing ops for any unexpected usage alerts.

Aisha (CSM): Action items: @Li to apply autoscale policy and pre-warm KV (today EOD); @Tom to provision soft-throttle policy and slot lock (tomorrow morning); @Priya to kick off smoke and soak scripts during the window; @Marco to run the enablement call. I'll update the health score doc after the handoff.

ops-bot: scheduled-test reminder: "NovaCorp dedicated warmup" set for 2024-03-21T16:00:00Z (Thu 09:00 PST). Automatic post-run summary will be uploaded to the thread. :rocket:

Tom (SRE): Noted. I'll also attach a short checklist for incident escalation: runbook snippets, alert thresholds, and contact matrix.

Aisha (CSM): Thanks — let's try to keep replies short. If anyone runs into quota mismatch, call me immediately. We'll capture feedback in the post-run form and loop in renewals if anything impacts SLA. :thumbsup:
